subject: gk
question: In which of the following states is the Thousand Pillar temple located, in which thousand pillars are built?
solution:
**The correct answer is __Telangana.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __**The Thousand Pillar Temple, also known as the Rudreshwara Swamy Temple is located in the town of Hanamakonda, Telangana.**__

__
 
• It is **dedicated to Lord Shiva, Vishnu and Surya.**
 
• It was **constructed under the patronage of Ganapati Deva, Rudrama Devi and Prataparudra** who were of **Kakatiya dynasty. **
 
• **Construction** took place between **1175–1324 CE.**
 
• During the invasion by the **Tughlaq dynasty**, it was **desecrated**.
 
• But was **rebuilt by** the **7th Nizam of Hyderabad, Mir Osman Ali Khan.**
 
• It was **listed by the UNESCO as a world heritage site.**
